facts.claim: Across 2,408 audited tests, 17.4% of A/B tests reached statistical significance with a winning variant
facts.source_title: A/B Test Win Rate: Benchmarks From 2,288 Audited Tests
facts.excerpt: 17.4% of A/B tests reached statistical significance with a winning variant across 2,408 tests.

facts.claim: Winning tests average an 8.4% lift with a 6.1% median
facts.source_title: A/B Test Win Rate: Benchmarks From 2,288 Audited Tests
facts.excerpt: The average lift on winning tests is 8.4%, median 6.1%.

facts.claim: Winning tests delivered a median 1.88% conversion uplift and 2.77% revenue per visitor uplift
facts.excerpt: Winners delivered a median +1.88% conversion rate uplift and +2.77% revenue per visitor uplift.

facts.claim: AI apps hold a 41% year-one realised LTV premium: 30.16 dollars median against 21.37 for non-AI apps
facts.excerpt: AI apps sustain a 41% Year 1 realized LTV premium ($30.16 median vs $21.37 median).

facts.claim: The median Rule of 40 score was 25% in 2025, and the measure only starts to bite from about 20 million dollars ARR
facts.source_title: Rule of 40 in SaaS: 2026 Data, Benchmarks and Valuation Impact
facts.excerpt: The 2025 median Rule of 40 score is 25%. The Rule of 40 becomes a meaningful benchmark at roughly $20M ARR and above.

facts.claim: India has 601 million OTT users and 119 million paying subscribers
facts.source_title: India's OTT Market Hits 601 Million Users, But Only 119 Million Pay
facts.excerpt: Despite a massive base of 601 million OTT users, only 119 million are active paying subscribers.
